In this lesson, you will practice conversing in English by answering questions on different topics such as TRAVEL, WORK, PERSONALITY, GENDER ROLES, DISCRIMINATION and others. When responding, you are encouraged to use complete and longer sentences. You are also expected to expound on your answers and  provide evidence or explanations for your choices and opinions.

LESSON DURATION: To allow time for preparation and short breaks, lesson durations are as follows:
1-hour lesson → 55 minutes (for new and old students)
45-minute lesson → 42 minutes (for new students only)
30-minute lesson → 28 minutes (for new students only)

***This lesson is NOT for doing homework or any other school activity.
***If you miss a class because you booked the wrong time, I won't make up for it. Please check your time zone setting and manually set the time zone as necessary.

pro_course_detail.title: Basic Tagalog for Beginners - (Existing Students)
pro_course_detail.description:
We will discuss basic words and common, useful phrases.

Basic Tagalog words for colors, numbers, body parts, days of the week, months of the year, people, nature, animals, directions and many more.

Common used Tagalog greeting like "Magandang Araw" for Good day! And simple Tagalog phrases we use to start a conversation like "Kamusta ka?" for How are you?

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Tagalog for Certain Situations - (Existing Students)
pro_course_detail.description: We will learn and discuss how to exchange conversation in situations like asking for directions, ordering food in a restaurant, attending a wedding, asking for the price in the market, while waiting for our flight in the airport, meeting a Filipino or Tagalog speaker for the first time and many more.

pro_course_detail.description: Let's have a free talk where you can practice your English through having conversation with me. As we speak in English you will be able to practice and I will be able to correct your grammar, sentence structure and pronunciation. No need for you to worry about what topics to discuss for I have a prepared list of topics that we may discuss or if you have a topic that you want to discuss, just let me know and we'll try to discuss it.
